issue_context.summary: An open Workspaces issue reports that a captured Laney UWP app on a multi-monitor desktop is detected but not visibly launched.
known_information: Live state is open; reporter Kenya-West; no current assignees; labels: Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, Needs-Team-Response, Product-Workspaces.
The initial report says PowerToys 0.85.1, Windows 11 23H2, Microsoft Store install, not running as administrator, and Laney on the rightmost of three monitors.
Steps: install/open Laney, capture a Workspace, close Laney, then launch that Workspace. The expected result is Laney visible; the reported result is no visible launch.
The reporter supplied three public reports across Dec 2024 and Jan 2025 and a screencast; the Dec 4 report says the app is detected but absent and has no status label.
The Jan 30, 2025 comment says another user encountered the same problem.
inferences: A UWP activation/readiness or status-reporting problem is plausible, but the public discussion does not distinguish it from the app starting behind or off-screen.
The later report mentions Windows 11 24H2 but does not state an exact PowerToys version.
issue_context.analysis: The issue has stronger reproduction evidence than a generic log request: the author repeated the flow after an updated-report request, provided a video, and another user confirmed the symptom. A focused local reproduction is the evidence-first next step. Do not infer a Workspaces code defect until the app process/window and status-modal behavior are observed.
